comments.author: SproutsJeremy
comments.body:
Assuming they really don’t use loras, they probably just have a good workflow. 

Good Prompts: Depending on on the hair style & clothing prompts you give an AI, they can give the same hairstyle and clothing each time or a wildly different hairstyle and clothing each time. 

Good Checkpoint: Some checkpoints give you wildly different character results everytime, other checkpoints give you very consistent characters. 

Good Lora: Same thing as good checkpoints. It’s important that both your checkpoint and lora are suitable to provide consistent characters. 

Custom Checkpoints & Loras: If your checkpoints/loras don’t generate consistent characters, train them yourself. This is probably what they do if they didn’t already have a good checkpoint/lora. 

Predraws: You can also get very consistent results if you pre draw then use the drawing as an input. You can also use another generation as a reference for a predraw to get more consistent results. 

Manual Edits: Same as predraws. You can shape your character manually with liquify or do typical photoshop adjustments to get your characters looking consistent. 

Workflows: Forge allows you to do some freaky stuff to get your generations looking exactly how you want them. 

It could be a ton of things though.
